items.title: Ricursive Intelligence is betting on AI-designed chips to help solve the compute crisis
items.summary: The founders detailed how their startup is developing AI that can design chips, learn from each iteration, and improve subsequent designs, all with the goal of automating and accelerating the chip design process.
items.creator: Aisha Malik

items.title: Flock CEO defends surveillance technology amid national backlash: ‘We shouldn’t pause progress’
items.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt, Flock CEO Garrett Langley defended his company's surveillance technology despite growing privacy concerns, arguing that its crime-fighting benefits outweigh the risks of abuse.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Meet the five companies competing in the Startup Battlefield finals at Disrupt 2026

items.creator: Anthony Ha
